thread:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing release notes + shuttle change window for Thu 09:00 PT. Need: pinned model version, rollback lanes, and internal announce copy. Who can take pin/rollback ops?
liam: I can own the pin + canary. Plan: canary -> 10% (15m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% with automated metric checks. deploy-bot will gate on 5xx rate and latency.
maya: thx. pin to `redwood/model-x:2026-03-18-quant`? or do we want rc tag? recommend pin to immutable digest if possible.
alex: would prefer immutable digest. if we must use tag, use `v2026-03-18-quant` and add fallback to `v2026-03-10-stable` on regressions.
maria: RN blurb draft: "Optimize: improved KV cache & quantization path, expected 12–18% token cost reduction; watch for beam search variance on long sequences." also call out known issue: rare init latency spike on cold pods (rollback lane: last stable digest).
deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: canary id=canary-2469009876, strategy=phased, metrics=[5xx_rate<0.5%, p95_latency<1200ms]. Commands:
```
redwood deploy --pin=sha256:ba7... --strategy=phased --canary-id=canary-2469009876
redwood rollback --to=sha256:11c... --reason="metric-regression"
```
ops-bot: Change window reserved Thu 09:00-10:30 PT. Noting: no tenant-facing downtime expected. Please flag if you need extended window.
liam: I'll add the RN link and the rollback playbook to the ops runbook. RN link: https://docs.internal/redwood/rn/2469009876
maya: For internal announcement: short callout in #general + staged pin note in #customers. Draft copy:
"Shipping optimizations for model-x Thursday 09:00 PT. No expected downtime. Rolling canary with automatic rollback on regressions. Full notes: <link>"
alex: Suggest adding an SLO note: "If p95 latency increases >30% or error rate >0.5% we will roll back." keeps expectations clear.
maria: LGTM. I'll proof RN and add the blurb for support triage steps.
maya: perfect. liam, confirm when canary hits 50% so we can post the internal update. :thumbsup: 
liam: will do, will post updates in this thread and ping @oncall.
maya: thanks everyone — final step: @deploy-bot please start the canary at Thu 09:00 PT, and @ops-bot keep the change window pinned.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary-2469009876 at 2026-03-19T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Monitoring hooks attached.
liam: first check at +15m, will report.
maya: closing loop — RN ready, announce copy ready, ops ready. :rocket:
